name: Add and delete events in the timeline
description: Validates that timeline rows can be added and removed while the invoices remain in sync.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, click 'Simulator' in the top navigation bar, and choose 'S05' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Assert the timeline has 3 events and Invoice 2 totals $103.20
Assert the timeline has 3 events, Invoice 2 totals $103.20 and the '✅ Matches golden expected' badge is shown
